title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Nomination Procedures, etc.)
(1) An individual, corporation, or organization may, through the Minister of the National Court Administration, nominate a person considered suitable for recommendation for appointment as a Justice of the Supreme Court to the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, or submit other opinions concerning the recommendation for appointment of Justices of the Supreme Court, in writing (excluding facsimile transmission and electronic mail). The same shall apply where a member makes a nomination.
(2) A nomination under paragraph (1) shall be made confidentially, specifying the nominee's principal personal details, including education and career history, and the reasons for the nomination.
